title: Hosted gateway rate limits
description: The object in wrangler.jsonc's RATE_LIMITS var (a JSON string). src/ratelimit.js reads it at request time. The Durable Object enforces it; this schema does not.

address.description: Requests per period for one CF-Connecting-IP (an IPv6 address by its /64), every /mcp request.

caller.description: tools/call messages per period for one bearer token, keyed by its hex SHA-256.

period.description: Fixed window length in seconds. 10 or 60, the periods Workers Rate Limiting used to allow.
